auxiliary_orbitals: canonical ground orbitals at the anchor, frozen in its co-rotating orthonormal AO frame; no re-canonicalization away from the anchor
target_orbitals: complete analytic stationary-ground and orthogonality-constrained ROKS first and second KKT response
native_diagonal_energy: full semiempirical density and explicit geometry response, including fractional-spin four-open-shell charge energy
spin_completion: analytic SU(2) Heisenberg completion of the same frozen spin response; no additional coefficient
physical_off_diagonal_operators: h and ERI frozen in the identical co-rotating orthonormal frame
excitation_reference: full SI excited eigenvalue minus stationary ground functional energy, with both nuclear responses retained
finite_differences: independent validation only; never used to assemble gradients or Hessians
validation: Criegee and Furofuran, matrix symmetry, translational invariance, independently reoptimized displaced energy values
limitations: anchored PES, not a newly self-consistent DFA at each geometry; no near-degenerate single-root derivative claims
